renderer: Offline Chromium / Edge using actual page CSS and markup
scope: 375px free/member, sheet-edit/search, v343 and v350 scenarios; visible controls and displayed input placeholders only, not a whole-screen WCAG certification.
method: Up to nine rendered background samples per control after scrolling. Only points where the control or its descendant is topmost are measured; occluded/hidden controls are recorded separately. Glyphs and images are hidden without changing layout. Placeholder foreground comes from ::placeholder, including its opacity and color alpha composited over the sampled background. Filled inputs have no displayed placeholder and are excluded. Thresholds remain 4.5 for normal text and 3 for large text; disabled controls are reported but exempt. Active controls with element/ancestor group opacity between 0 and 1 fail closed as unsupported_group_opacity; their already-composited surfaces cannot safely be combined with opaque foreground colors.
limitations: Transparent bar content changes while scrolling. Removing background glyphs isolates intended surface colors; overlapping moving text and device-specific blur require visual/device review. Icon shape and icon contrast are not part of this test.
